const:graph.build.queries.CREATE_SPEC_NO.name: build_create_spec_nodes
const:graph.build.queries.CREATE_SPEC_NO.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: row.uuid}) ON CREATE SET n:$(row.label) SET n += row.props RETURN count(n) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.DELETE_SPEC_NO.name: build_delete_spec_nodes
const:graph.build.queries.DELETE_SPEC_NO.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: row.uuid}) DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.INFER_XDOC_DOC.name: build_infer_xdoc_documents
const:graph.build.queries.INFER_XDOC_DOC.text: UNWIND $document_ids AS document_id MATCH (d:Document {group_id: $project_id, document_id: document_id}) RETURN d.document_id AS document_id, CASE WHEN coalesce(d.title, '') <> '' THEN d.title WHEN coalesce(d.path, '') <> '' THEN d.path ELSE d.document_id END AS title ORDER BY document_id

const:graph.build.queries.INFER_XDOC_EMB.name: build_infer_xdoc_embeddings
const:graph.build.queries.INFER_XDOC_EMB.text: UNWIND $uuids AS uuid MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: uuid}) WHERE n.embedding IS NOT NULL RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, n.embedding AS embedding ORDER BY uuid

const:graph.build.queries.INFER_XDOC_MEM.name: build_infer_xdoc_members
const:graph.build.queries.INFER_XDOC_MEM.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.uuid IS NOT NULL AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $subject_labels) CALL (n) { OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(v:SpecNode) WHERE type(r) IN $via AND r.group_id = $project_id AND coalesce(r.basis, 'stated') IN $bases AND v.group_id = $project_id AND v.uuid IS NOT NULL AND v.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(v) WHERE label IN $member_labels) WITH n, collect(DISTINCT v) AS linked OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[l:MENTIONED_IN]->(f:Fragment)<-[e:REFERENCED_BY]-(g:SpecNode) WHERE $mentions AND g <> n AND l.group_id = $project_id AND e.group_id = $project_id AND f.group_id = $project_id AND f.status IN $statuses AND g.group_id = $project_id AND g.uuid IS NOT NULL AND g.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(g) WHERE label IN $member_labels) WITH n, linked, collect(DISTINCT g) AS mentioned WITH n, linked + mentioned AS named OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[o:REFERENCED_BY]->(h:Fragment)<-[q:REFERENCED_BY]-(s:SpecNode) WHERE $mentions AND s <> n AND NOT s IN named AND o.group_id = $project_id AND q.group_id = $project_id AND h.group_id = $project_id AND h.status IN $statuses AND s.group_id = $project_id AND s.uuid IS NOT NULL AND s.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(s) WHERE label IN $member_labels) WITH named, s, collect(DISTINCT h.fragment_id) AS fragments WITH named, collect(CASE WHEN s IS NOT NULL THEN {node: s, shared: fragments} END) AS grounded UNWIND [m IN named | {node: m, shared: null}] + grounded AS item RETURN DISTINCT item.node AS m, item.shared AS shared } CALL (m) { MATCH (m)-[e:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE e.group_id = $project_id AND f.group_id = $project_id AND f.status IN $statuses AND f.document_id IS NOT NULL RETURN collect(DISTINCT f.document_id) AS documents } WITH n, m, shared, documents WHERE size(documents) > 0 WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN shared IS NULL THEN {uuid: m.uuid, documents: documents} ELSE {uuid: m.uuid, documents: documents, shared: shared, name: m.name, quote: m[$quote], statements: m.statements} END) AS members WHERE size(members) > 1 RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, n.spec_id AS spec_id, n.name AS name, [key IN [n.identity_key] + coalesce(n.identity_aliases, []) WHERE key IS NOT NULL] AS keys, members ORDER BY spec_id, uuid

const:graph.build.queries.MERGE_SPEC_NOD.name: build_merge_spec_nodes
const:graph.build.queries.MERGE_SPEC_NOD.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (new:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: row.survivor}) SET new.spec_id_aliases = row.aliases, new.last_build_id = $build_id WITH new, row CALL (new, row) { UNWIND row.merged AS merged MATCH (old:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: merged}) WHERE old <> new CALL (old, new) { MATCH (old)-[r]-() WHERE NOT type(r) IN $owned_types WITH DISTINCT old, new, r WITH new, r, type(r) AS rel_type, properties(r) AS props, startNode(r) = old AS outgoing, (startNode(r) = new OR endNode(r) = new) AS between, CASE WHEN startNode(r) = endNode(r) THEN new WHEN startNode(r) = old THEN endNode(r) ELSE startNode(r) END AS other FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (new)-[x]->(other) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (new)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(other) SET moved += props) FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND NOT outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (other)-[x]->(new) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (other)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(new) SET moved += props) DELETE r } DETACH DELETE old } RETURN count(new) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.READ_CURRENT_F.name: build_read_current_fragments
const:graph.build.queries.READ_CURRENT_F.text: MATCH (f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND f.fragment_id IS NOT NULL RETURN f.fragment_id AS fragment_id, f.document_id AS document_id, f.spec_id AS spec_id, f.heading_path AS heading_path, f.ordinal AS ordinal, f.line_start AS line_start, f.line_end AS line_end, f.content_hash AS content_hash, f.status AS status, f.extracted_hash AS extracted_hash, f.error_code AS error_code ORDER BY fragment_id

const:graph.build.queries.READ_CURRENT_L.name: build_read_current_links
const:graph.build.queries.READ_CURRENT_L.text: CALL () { MATCH (n:SpecNode)-[r:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.uuid IS NOT NULL AND f.group_id = $project_id RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, type(r) AS kind, f.fragment_id AS fragment_id, coalesce(f.document_id, '') AS document_id, r.line_start AS line_start, r.line_end AS line_end, null AS count, CASE WHEN f.text IS NOT NULL AND f.line_start IS NOT NULL AND r.line_start IS NOT NULL AND r.line_end IS NOT NULL THEN split(f.text, '\n')[r.line_start - f.line_start .. r.line_end - f.line_start + 1] ELSE [] END AS lines UNION ALL MATCH (n:SpecNode)-[m:MENTIONED_IN]->(f:Fragment) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.uuid IS NOT NULL AND f.group_id = $project_id RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, type(m) AS kind, f.fragment_id AS fragment_id, coalesce(f.document_id, '') AS document_id, null AS line_start, null AS line_end, m.count AS count, [] AS lines } RETURN uuid, kind, fragment_id, document_id, line_start, line_end, count, lines ORDER BY uuid, kind, fragment_id, line_start

const:graph.build.queries.READ_CURRENT_N.name: build_read_current_nodes
const:graph.build.queries.READ_CURRENT_N.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.uuid IS NOT NULL RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, labels(n) AS labels, n {.*, embedding: null, name_embedding: null} AS props ORDER BY uuid

const:graph.build.queries.READ_INFER_FRA.name: build_read_infer_fragments
const:graph.build.queries.READ_INFER_FRA.text: UNWIND $fragment_ids AS fragment_id MATCH (f:Fragment {group_id: $project_id, fragment_id: fragment_id}) RETURN f.fragment_id AS fragment_id, coalesce(f.text, '') AS text ORDER BY fragment_id

const:graph.build.queries.READ_INFER_NOD.name: build_read_infer_nodes
const:graph.build.queries.READ_INFER_NOD.text: UNWIND $uuids AS node_uuid MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: node_uuid}) CALL (n) { OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND f.fragment_id IS NOT NULL AND f.text IS NOT NULL AND f.status IN $statuses WITH f, min(r.line_start) AS line ORDER BY f.document_id, f.ordinal, f.fragment_id LIMIT $per_node WITH f, CASE WHEN f IS NULL OR line IS NULL OR f.line_start IS NULL OR line < f.line_start THEN [] ELSE split(f.text, '\n')[0..(line - f.line_start + 1)] END AS above RETURN collect(f {.fragment_id, .document_id, content_hash: coalesce(f.content_hash, ''), heading_path: coalesce(f.heading_path, []), headings: [text_line IN above WHERE text_line =~ ' {0,3}(#{1,6}([ \t].*)?|```.*|~~~.*)']}) AS fragments } RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, n.spec_id AS spec_id, coalesce(n.name, '') AS name, n.identity_key AS identity_key, coalesce(n[$quote], '') AS quote, [label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels] AS labels, n.statements AS statements, fragments ORDER BY uuid

const:graph.build.queries.READ_PERSISTED.name: build_read_persisted_documents
const:graph.build.queries.READ_PERSISTED.text: MATCH (d:Document) WHERE d.group_id = $project_id AND d.document_id IS NOT NULL RETURN d.document_id AS document_id, coalesce(d.revision_id, '') AS revision_id, coalesce(d.version, 0) AS version, coalesce(d.path, d.document_id) AS path, coalesce(d.title, '') AS title, coalesce(d.status, 'active') AS status ORDER BY path, document_id

const:graph.build.queries.READ_PERSISTED.name: build_read_persisted_fragments
const:graph.build.queries.READ_PERSISTED.text: MATCH (f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND f.fragment_id IS NOT NULL AND f.document_id IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(f.status, 'active') <> 'retired' RETURN f.fragment_id AS fragment_id, f.document_id AS document_id, coalesce(f.heading_path, []) AS heading_path, coalesce(f.ordinal, 0) AS ordinal, coalesce(f.line_start, 0) AS line_start, coalesce(f.line_end, 0) AS line_end, coalesce(f.text, '') AS text, coalesce(f.content_hash, '') AS content_hash, coalesce(f.status, 'active') AS status, f.extracted_hash AS extracted_hash, f.error_code AS error_code ORDER BY document_id, ordinal, fragment_id

const:graph.build.queries.READ_PERSISTED.name: build_read_persisted_hubs
const:graph.build.queries.READ_PERSISTED.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.name IS NOT NULL WITH n, [label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels] AS hub WHERE size(hub) > 0 RETURN n.name AS name, hub[0] AS label, coalesce(n.identity_aliases, []) AS aliases ORDER BY name, label

const:graph.build.queries.READ_PERSISTED.name: build_read_persisted_presence
const:graph.build.queries.READ_PERSISTED.text: RETURN EXISTS { MATCH (d:Document) WHERE d.group_id = $project_id } AS documents, EXISTS { MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id } AS spec_nodes

const:graph.build.queries.READ_SPINE_EDG.name: build_read_spine_edges
const:graph.build.queries.READ_SPINE_EDG.text: MATCH (s:SpecNode)-[r]->(t:SpecNode) WHERE s.group_id = $project_id AND s.uuid IS NOT NULL AND type(r) IN $relations AND r.group_id = $project_id AND t.group_id = $project_id RETURN type(r) AS relation, s.uuid AS source, t.uuid AS target, coalesce(r.basis, 'stated') AS basis, r.inference_rule AS inference_rule ORDER BY relation, source, target

const:graph.build.queries.READ_SPINE_NOD.name: build_read_spine_nodes
const:graph.build.queries.READ_SPINE_NOD.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.uuid IS NOT NULL RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, n.spec_id AS spec_id, [label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels] AS labels, [name IN $attributes WHERE n[name] IS NOT NULL | [name, n[name]]] AS attributes ORDER BY uuid

const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_DELETE_.name: build_repair_delete_edges
const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_DELETE_.text: UNWIND $ids AS id MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE elementId(r) = id AND r.group_id = $project_id AND type(r) IN $relations DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_DELETE_.name: build_repair_delete_nodes
const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_DELETE_.text: UNWIND $ids AS id MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE elementId(n) = id AND n.group_id = $project_id DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_EDGE_EV.name: build_repair_edge_evidence
const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_EDGE_EV.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r]->() WHERE elementId(r) = row.id AND r.group_id = $project_id AND type(r) IN $relations SET r.source_fragment_ids = row.fragment_ids RETURN count(r) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_NODE_EV.name: build_repair_node_evidence
const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_NODE_EV.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE elementId(n) = row.id AND n.group_id = $project_id CALL (n, row) { UNWIND row.evidence AS ev MATCH (f:Fragment {group_id: $project_id, fragment_id: ev.fragment_id}) MERGE (n)-[:REFERENCED_BY {group_id: $project_id, line_start: ev.line_start, line_end: ev.line_end}]->(f) } RETURN count(n) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_SET_LAB.name: build_repair_set_labels
const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_SET_LAB.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE elementId(n) = row.id AND n.group_id = $project_id REMOVE n:$(row.remove) SET n:$(row.label), n.label_disagreement = row.label_disagreement RETURN count(n) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_SET_SPE.name: build_repair_set_spec_ids
const:graph.build.queries.REPAIR_SET_SPE.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE elementId(n) = row.id AND n.group_id = $project_id SET n.spec_id = row.spec_id, n.spec_id_aliases = row.aliases RETURN count(n) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.REPLACE_NODE_L.name: build_replace_node_links
const:graph.build.queries.REPLACE_NODE_L.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: row.uuid}) CALL (n) { OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[o:REFERENCED_BY|MENTIONED_IN]->(:Fragment) DELETE o } CALL (n, row) { UNWIND row.evidence AS ev MERGE (f:Fragment {group_id: $project_id, fragment_id: ev.fragment_id}) CREATE (n)-[:REFERENCED_BY {group_id: $project_id, line_start: ev.line_start, line_end: ev.line_end}]->(f) } CALL (n, row) { UNWIND row.mentions AS m MERGE (f:Fragment {group_id: $project_id, fragment_id: m.fragment_id}) CREATE (n)-[:MENTIONED_IN {group_id: $project_id, count: m.count}]->(f) } RETURN count(n) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.SET_DOCUMENT_S.name: build_set_document_status
const:graph.build.queries.SET_DOCUMENT_S.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (d:Document {group_id: $project_id, document_id: row.document_id}) SET d.status = row.status, d.last_build_id = $build_id RETURN count(d) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.SET_FRAGMENT_S.name: build_set_fragment_status
const:graph.build.queries.SET_FRAGMENT_S.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (f:Fragment {group_id: $project_id, fragment_id: row.fragment_id}) SET f.status = row.status, f.error_code = row.error_code, f.last_build_id = $build_id RETURN count(f) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.UPDATE_SPEC_NO.name: build_update_spec_nodes
const:graph.build.queries.UPDATE_SPEC_NO.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: row.uuid}) SET n += row.props RETURN count(n) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.UPSERT_DOCUMEN.name: build_upsert_documents
const:graph.build.queries.UPSERT_DOCUMEN.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MERGE (d:Document {group_id: $project_id, document_id: row.document_id}) SET d += row.props, d.last_build_id = $build_id RETURN count(d) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.UPSERT_FRAGMEN.name: build_upsert_fragments
const:graph.build.queries.UPSERT_FRAGMEN.text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH (d:Document {group_id: $project_id, document_id: row.document_id}) MERGE (f:Fragment {group_id: $project_id, fragment_id: row.fragment_id}) SET f += row.props, f.last_build_id = $build_id MERGE (d)-[:CONTAINS {group_id: $project_id}]->(f) RETURN count(f) AS written

const:graph.build.queries.VERIFY_DOMAIN_.name: build_verify_domain_edges
const:graph.build.queries.VERIFY_DOMAIN_.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode)-[r]-() WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND r.group_id = $project_id AND type(r) IN $relations WITH DISTINCT r RETURN elementId(r) AS id, type(r) AS relation, r.uuid AS uuid, r.edge_key AS edge_key, r.basis AS basis, r.source_fragment_ids AS fragment_ids, r.inference_rule AS inference_rule, r.confidence AS confidence, r.evidence AS evidence, elementId(startNode(r)) AS source, elementId(endNode(r)) AS target ORDER BY relation, id

const:graph.build.queries.VERIFY_FRAGMEN.name: build_verify_fragments
const:graph.build.queries.VERIFY_FRAGMEN.text: MATCH (f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id RETURN f.fragment_id AS fragment_id, f.document_id AS document_id, f.status AS status, f.content_hash AS content_hash, f.extracted_hash AS extracted_hash, EXISTS { MATCH (n:SpecNode)-[:REFERENCED_BY]->(f) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id } AS grounds ORDER BY document_id, fragment_id

const:graph.build.queries.VERIFY_SPEC_NO.name: build_verify_spec_nodes
const:graph.build.queries.VERIFY_SPEC_NO.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id RETURN elementId(n) AS id, n.uuid AS uuid, n.spec_id AS spec_id, n.name AS name, n.identity_key AS identity_key, n.identity_aliases AS identity_aliases, n.spec_id_aliases AS spec_id_aliases, n.label_disagreement AS label_disagreement, [label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels] AS labels, [name IN $attributes WHERE n[name] IS NOT NULL | [name, n[name]]] AS attributes, [(n)-[:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id | f.fragment_id] AS evidence ORDER BY id

const:graph.core.queries.COUNT_NODES.name: count_nodes
const:graph.core.queries.COUNT_NODES.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels) RETURN count(n) AS total

const:graph.core.queries.COUNT_SEARCH_VE.name: count_search_vectors
const:graph.core.queries.COUNT_SEARCH_VE.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.embedding IS NOT NULL AND n.group_id = $project_id AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels) AND all(name IN keys($where) WHERE n[name] = $where[name] OR (n[name] IS NULL AND (any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN coalesce($defaulted[name], [])) XOR $where[name] IS NULL))) RETURN count(CASE WHEN n.embedding_model = $model THEN 1 END) AS matching, count(n) AS stored

const:graph.core.queries.DELETE_SPEC_NOD.name: delete_spec_node
const:graph.core.queries.DELETE_SPEC_NOD.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $key}) WHERE $label IN labels(n) DETACH DELETE n RETURN count(*) AS deleted

const:graph.core.queries.MOVE_FOREIGN_RE.name: move_foreign_relationships
const:graph.core.queries.MOVE_FOREIGN_RE.text: MATCH (old:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $from_key}) WHERE $from_label IN labels(old) MATCH (new:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $to_key}) WHERE $to_label IN labels(new) AND new <> old MATCH (old)-[r]-(other) WHERE NOT type(r) IN $owned_types WITH DISTINCT old, new, r WITH new, r, type(r) AS rel_type, properties(r) AS props, startNode(r) = old AS outgoing, (startNode(r) = new OR endNode(r) = new) AS between, CASE WHEN startNode(r) = endNode(r) THEN new WHEN startNode(r) = old THEN endNode(r) ELSE startNode(r) END AS other FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (new)-[x]->(other) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (new)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(other) SET moved += props) FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND NOT outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (other)-[x]->(new) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (other)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(new) SET moved += props) DELETE r RETURN count(r) AS moved

const:graph.core.queries.READ_DOCUMENTS.name: read_documents
const:graph.core.queries.READ_DOCUMENTS.text: MATCH (d:Document) WHERE d.group_id = $project_id AND d.document_id IS NOT NULL RETURN properties(d) AS props ORDER BY d.path, d.document_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_EDGES.name: read_edges
const:graph.core.queries.READ_EDGES.text: MATCH (s:SpecNode)-[r]->(t:SpecNode) WHERE s.group_id = $project_id AND s.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND type(r) IN $relations AND r.group_id = $project_id AND t.group_id = $project_id AND any(label IN labels(s) WHERE label IN $labels) AND any(label IN labels(t) WHERE label IN $labels) AND ($include_inferred OR coalesce(r.basis, '') <> $inferred) RETURN type(r) AS relation, s.spec_id AS source, t.spec_id AS target, properties(r) AS props ORDER BY source, relation, target, r.edge_key

const:graph.core.queries.READ_FRAGMENTS.name: read_fragments
const:graph.core.queries.READ_FRAGMENTS.text: MATCH (f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND f.fragment_id IS NOT NULL AND ($document_id IS NULL OR f.document_id = $document_id) RETURN properties(f) AS props ORDER BY f.document_id, f.ordinal, f.fragment_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_FRAGMENT_H.name: read_fragment_hits
const:graph.core.queries.READ_FRAGMENT_H.text: MATCH (f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND f.fragment_id IN $fragment_ids OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Document {group_id: $project_id, document_id: f.document_id}) RETURN properties(f) AS props, properties(d) AS document

const:graph.core.queries.READ_IMPACT_HOP.name: read_impact_hop
const:graph.core.queries.READ_IMPACT_HOP.text: MATCH (s:SpecNode) WHERE s.group_id = $project_id AND s.uuid IN $frontier MATCH (s)-[r]-(m:SpecNode) WHERE type(r) IN $relations AND r.group_id = $project_id AND m.group_id = $project_id AND m.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT m.uuid IN $seen AND any(label IN labels(m) WHERE label IN $labels) WITH DISTINCT m RETURN m.uuid AS uuid, m.spec_id AS spec_id ORDER BY spec_id LIMIT $limit

const:graph.core.queries.READ_NEIGHBOURS.name: read_neighbours
const:graph.core.queries.READ_NEIGHBOURS.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, spec_id: $spec_id}) MATCH (n)-[r]-(m:SpecNode) WHERE type(r) IN $relations AND r.group_id = $project_id AND m.group_id = $project_id AND any(label IN labels(m) WHERE label IN $labels) WITH DISTINCT r, startNode(r) AS s, endNode(r) AS t RETURN type(r) AS relation, s.spec_id AS source, t.spec_id AS target, properties(r) AS props ORDER BY source, relation, target, r.edge_key

const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES.name: read_nodes
const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels) AND all(name IN keys($where) WHERE n[name] = $where[name] OR (n[name] IS NULL AND (any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN coalesce($defaulted[name], [])) XOR $where[name] IS NULL))) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[ref:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND coalesce(f.status, '') <> $retired OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Document)-[:CONTAINS]->(f) WHERE d.group_id = $project_id WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN f IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {fragment_id: f.fragment_id, document_id: f.document_id, path: d.path, line_start: ref.line_start, line_end: ref.line_end} END) AS provenance RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n {.*, embedding: null, name_embedding: null} AS props, provenance ORDER BY n.spec_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES_BY_I.name: read_nodes_by_ids
const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES_BY_I.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels) AND all(name IN keys($where) WHERE n[name] = $where[name] OR (n[name] IS NULL AND (any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN coalesce($defaulted[name], [])) XOR $where[name] IS NULL))) AND (n.identity_key IN $keys OR any(key IN coalesce(n.identity_aliases, []) WHERE key IN $keys) OR n.spec_id IN $spec_ids OR any(alias IN coalesce(n.spec_id_aliases, []) WHERE alias IN $spec_ids)) RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, n.spec_id AS spec_id, [n.identity_key] + coalesce(n.identity_aliases, []) AS keys, [n.spec_id] + coalesce(n.spec_id_aliases, []) AS spec_ids ORDER BY spec_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES_BY_U.name: read_nodes_by_uuid
const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES_BY_U.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.uuid IN $uuids AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[ref:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND coalesce(f.status, '') <> $retired OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Document)-[:CONTAINS]->(f) WHERE d.group_id = $project_id WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN f IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {fragment_id: f.fragment_id, document_id: f.document_id, path: d.path, line_start: ref.line_start, line_end: ref.line_end} END) AS provenance RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n {.*, embedding: null, name_embedding: null} AS props, provenance ORDER BY n.spec_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES_FOR_.name: read_nodes_for_lines
const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES_FOR_.text: MATCH (:Document {group_id: $project_id, document_id: $document_id})-[:CONTAINS]->(f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND coalesce(f.status, '') <> $retired MATCH (n:SpecNode)-[ref:REFERENCED_BY]->(f) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels) AND coalesce(ref.line_start, f.line_start) <= $line_end AND coalesce(ref.line_end, f.line_end) >= $line_start WITH DISTINCT n OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[ref:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND coalesce(f.status, '') <> $retired OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Document)-[:CONTAINS]->(f) WHERE d.group_id = $project_id WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN f IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {fragment_id: f.fragment_id, document_id: f.document_id, path: d.path, line_start: ref.line_start, line_end: ref.line_end} END) AS provenance RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n {.*, embedding: null, name_embedding: null} AS props, provenance ORDER BY n.spec_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES_PAGE.name: read_nodes_page
const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODES_PAGE.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels) AND ($after IS NULL OR n.spec_id > $after) WITH n ORDER BY n.spec_id LIMIT $limit OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[ref:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND coalesce(f.status, '') <> $retired OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Document)-[:CONTAINS]->(f) WHERE d.group_id = $project_id WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN f IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {fragment_id: f.fragment_id, document_id: f.document_id, path: d.path, line_start: ref.line_start, line_end: ref.line_end} END) AS provenance RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n {.*, embedding: null, name_embedding: null} AS props, provenance ORDER BY n.spec_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODE_BY_AL.name: read_node_by_alias
const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODE_BY_AL.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND $spec_id IN coalesce(n.spec_id_aliases, []) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[ref:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND coalesce(f.status, '') <> $retired OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Document)-[:CONTAINS]->(f) WHERE d.group_id = $project_id WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN f IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {fragment_id: f.fragment_id, document_id: f.document_id, path: d.path, line_start: ref.line_start, line_end: ref.line_end} END) AS provenance RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n {.*, embedding: null, name_embedding: null} AS props, provenance ORDER BY n.spec_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODE_BY_SP.name: read_node_by_spec_id
const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODE_BY_SP.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, spec_id: $spec_id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[ref:REFERENCED_BY]->(f:Fragment) WHERE f.group_id = $project_id AND coalesce(f.status, '') <> $retired OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Document)-[:CONTAINS]->(f) WHERE d.group_id = $project_id WITH n, collect(CASE WHEN f IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE {fragment_id: f.fragment_id, document_id: f.document_id, path: d.path, line_start: ref.line_start, line_end: ref.line_end} END) AS provenance RETURN labels(n) AS labels, n {.*, embedding: null, name_embedding: null} AS props, provenance ORDER BY n.spec_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODE_UUIDS.name: read_node_uuids_by_spec_id
const:graph.core.queries.READ_NODE_UUIDS.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels) AND (n.spec_id IN $spec_ids OR any(alias IN coalesce(n.spec_id_aliases, []) WHERE alias IN $spec_ids)) RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, n.spec_id AS spec_id ORDER BY spec_id

const:graph.core.queries.READ_OWNER_VALU.name: read_owner_values
const:graph.core.queries.READ_OWNER_VALU.text: UNWIND $requests AS request MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: request.uuid})-[r]->(o:SpecNode) WHERE type(r) = request.relation AND r.group_id = $project_id AND o.group_id = $project_id AND o.spec_id IS NOT NULL RETURN request.uuid AS uuid, request.relation AS relation, labels(o) AS labels, o.spec_id AS spec_id, [name IN request.attributes | [name, o[name]]] AS attribute_values ORDER BY uuid, relation, spec_id

const:graph.core.queries.SEARCH_FRAGMENT.name: search_fragments
const:graph.core.queries.SEARCH_FRAGMENT.text: CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes($index, $query, {skip: $skip, limit: $page}) YIELD node, score WITH collect({f: node, score: score}) AS raw RETURN size(raw) AS fetched, [hit IN raw WHERE hit.f.group_id = $project_id AND hit.f.fragment_id IS NOT NULL AND hit.f.status = $active AND ($document_id IS NULL OR hit.f.document_id = $document_id) | {fragment_id: hit.f.fragment_id, score: hit.score}] AS hits

const:graph.core.queries.SEARCH_NODES_FU.name: search_nodes_fulltext
const:graph.core.queries.SEARCH_NODES_FU.text: CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes($index, $query, {skip: $skip, limit: $page}) YIELD node, score WITH collect({n: node, score: score}) AS raw RETURN size(raw) AS fetched, [hit IN raw WHERE hit.n.group_id = $project_id AND hit.n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(hit.n) WHERE label IN $labels) AND all(name IN keys($where) WHERE hit.n[name] = $where[name] OR (hit.n[name] IS NULL AND (any(label IN labels(hit.n) WHERE label IN coalesce($defaulted[name], [])) XOR $where[name] IS NULL))) | {uuid: hit.n.uuid, spec_id: hit.n.spec_id, score: hit.score}] AS hits

const:graph.core.queries.SEARCH_NODES_VE.name: search_nodes_vector
const:graph.core.queries.SEARCH_NODES_VE.text: CYPHER 5 CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes($index, $k, $vector) YIELD node, score WITH collect({n: node, score: score}) AS raw RETURN size(raw) AS fetched, [hit IN raw WHERE hit.n.embedding_model = $model AND hit.n.group_id = $project_id AND hit.n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(hit.n) WHERE label IN $labels) AND all(name IN keys($where) WHERE hit.n[name] = $where[name] OR (hit.n[name] IS NULL AND (any(label IN labels(hit.n) WHERE label IN coalesce($defaulted[name], [])) XOR $where[name] IS NULL))) | {uuid: hit.n.uuid, spec_id: hit.n.spec_id, score: hit.score}][..$limit] AS hits

const:graph.core.queries.SEARCH_NODES_VE.name: search_nodes_vector_exact
const:graph.core.queries.SEARCH_NODES_VE.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode) WHERE n.group_id = $project_id AND n.embedding IS NOT NULL AND n.embedding_model = $model AND size(n.embedding) = size($vector) AND n.group_id = $project_id AND n.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN $labels) AND all(name IN keys($where) WHERE n[name] = $where[name] OR (n[name] IS NULL AND (any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN coalesce($defaulted[name], [])) XOR $where[name] IS NULL))) WITH n, vector.similarity.cosine(n.embedding, $vector) AS score RETURN n.uuid AS uuid, n.spec_id AS spec_id, score ORDER BY score DESC, spec_id LIMIT $limit

const:graph.core.queries.SERVER_COMPONEN.name: server_components
const:graph.core.queries.SERVER_COMPONEN.text: CALL dbms.components() YIELD name, versions, edition RETURN name, versions, edition

const:graph.core.queries.SHOW_CONSTRAINT.name: show_constraints
const:graph.core.queries.SHOW_CONSTRAINT.text: SHOW CONSTRAINTS YIELD name, type, entityType, labelsOrTypes, properties RETURN name, type, entityType, labelsOrTypes, properties

const:graph.core.queries.SHOW_INDEXES.name: show_indexes
const:graph.core.queries.SHOW_INDEXES.text: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name, type, entityType, labelsOrTypes, properties, state, options RETURN name, type, entityType, labelsOrTypes, properties, state, options

const:graph.core.queries.SPEC_NODE_EXIST.name: spec_node_exists
const:graph.core.queries.SPEC_NODE_EXIST.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $n_key}) WHERE $n_label IN labels(n) RETURN count(n) AS found

const:graph.core.queries.SPEC_NODE_RELAT.name: spec_node_relationship_types
const:graph.core.queries.SPEC_NODE_RELAT.text: MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $n_key}) WHERE $n_label IN labels(n) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-() RETURN collect(DISTINCT type(r)) AS types

const:graph.core.queries.UPSERT_DOCUMENT.name: upsert_node_Document
const:graph.core.queries.UPSERT_DOCUMENT.text: MERGE (n:Document {group_id: $project_id, document_id: $key}) SET n += $props RETURN count(n) AS written

const:graph.core.queries.UPSERT_FRAGMENT.name: upsert_node_Fragment
const:graph.core.queries.UPSERT_FRAGMENT.text: MERGE (n:Fragment {group_id: $project_id, fragment_id: $key}) SET n += $props RETURN count(n) AS written

const:graph.core.queries.UPSERT_SPEC_NOD.name: upsert_spec_node
const:graph.core.queries.UPSERT_SPEC_NOD.text: OPTIONAL MATCH (old:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $key}) WITH old IS NOT NULL AND NOT $label IN labels(old) AS label_mismatch, old IS NOT NULL AND old.spec_id IS NOT NULL AND 'spec_id' IN keys($props) AND coalesce($props.spec_id <> old.spec_id, true) AS spec_id_changed FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN label_mismatch OR spec_id_changed THEN [] ELSE [1] END | MERGE (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $key}) ON CREATE SET n:$($label) SET n += $props) RETURN label_mismatch, spec_id_changed

gap:delete_edges(CARRIES).name: build_delete_edges_CARRIES
gap:delete_edges(CARRIES).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:CARRIES {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(CONSUMED_BY).name: build_delete_edges_CONSUMED_BY
gap:delete_edges(CONSUMED_BY).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:CONSUMED_BY {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(DEPENDS_ON).name: build_delete_edges_DEPENDS_ON
gap:delete_edges(DEPENDS_ON).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:DEPENDS_ON {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(DEPLOYED_TO).name: build_delete_edges_DEPLOYED_TO
gap:delete_edges(DEPLOYED_TO).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:DEPLOYED_TO {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(GROUPED_BY).name: build_delete_edges_GROUPED_BY
gap:delete_edges(GROUPED_BY).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:GROUPED_BY {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(INTEGRATES_WITH).name: build_delete_edges_INTEGRATES_WITH
gap:delete_edges(INTEGRATES_WITH).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:INTEGRATES_WITH {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(PART_OF).name: build_delete_edges_PART_OF
gap:delete_edges(PART_OF).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:PART_OF {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(PROVIDED_BY).name: build_delete_edges_PROVIDED_BY
gap:delete_edges(PROVIDED_BY).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:PROVIDED_BY {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(REALIZED_BY).name: build_delete_edges_REALIZED_BY
gap:delete_edges(REALIZED_BY).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:REALIZED_BY {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(RELATES_TO).name: build_delete_edges_RELATES_TO
gap:delete_edges(RELATES_TO).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:RELATES_TO {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:delete_edges(STORED_IN).name: build_delete_edges_STORED_IN
gap:delete_edges(STORED_IN).text: UNWIND $rows AS row MATCH ()-[r:STORED_IN {group_id: $project_id, edge_key: row.edge_key}]->() WHERE r.uuid = row.uuid OR r.uuid IS NULL DELETE r RETURN count(*) AS written

gap:infer.orphan(INF-CONT-01):build_infe.name: build_infer_exclusive_holders_PART_OF
gap:infer.orphan(INF-CONT-01):build_infe.text: UNWIND $uuids AS subject_uuid MATCH (n:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: subject_uuid})-[x:PART_OF]->(t:SpecNode) WHERE x.group_id = $project_id AND coalesce(x.basis, 'stated') IN $bases AND t.group_id = $project_id AND any(pair IN $pairs WHERE pair[0] IN labels(n) AND pair[1] IN labels(t)) RETURN DISTINCT n.uuid AS uuid ORDER BY uuid

gap:infer.orphan(INF-CONT-01):build_infe.name: build_infer_similar_targets_PART_OF

$mentions AND g <> n AND l.group_id = $project_id AND e.group_id = $project_id AND f.group_id = $project_id AND f.status IN $statuses AND g.group_id = $project_id AND g.uuid IS NOT NULL AND g.spec_id (n)-[o:REFERENCED_BY]->(h:Fragment)<-[q:REFERENCED_BY]-(s:SpecNode) WHERE $mentions AND s <> n AND NOT s IN named AND o.group_id = $project_id AND q.group_id = $project_id AND h.group_id = $project_id gap:writer.move_foreign_relationships#1.name: move_foreign_relationships
gap:writer.move_foreign_relationships#1.text: MATCH (old:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $from_key}) WHERE $from_label IN labels(old) MATCH (new:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $to_key}) WHERE $to_label IN labels(new) AND new <> old MATCH (old)-[r]-(other) WHERE NOT type(r) IN $owned_types WITH DISTINCT old, new, r WITH new, r, type(r) AS rel_type, properties(r) AS props, startNode(r) = old AS outgoing, (startNode(r) = new OR endNode(r) = new) AS between, CASE WHEN startNode(r) = endNode(r) THEN new WHEN startNode(r) = old THEN endNode(r) ELSE startNode(r) END AS other FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (new)-[x]->(other) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (new)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(other) SET moved += props) FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND NOT outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (other)-[x]->(new) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (other)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(new) SET moved += props) DELETE r RETURN count(r) AS moved

IS NOT NULL AND any(label IN labels(g) WHERE label IN $member_labels) WITH n, linked, collect(DISTINCT g) AS mentioned WITH n, linked + mentioned AS named OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[o:REFERENCED_BY]->(h:Fragment)<-[q:REFERENCED_BY]-(s:SpecNode) WHERE $mentions AND s <> n AND NOT s IN named AND o.group_id = $project_id AND q.group_id = $project_id AND h.group_id = $project_id renamed:writer.move_foreign_relationship.name: move_foreign_relationships
renamed:writer.move_foreign_relationship.text: MATCH (old:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $from_key}) WHERE $from_label IN labels(old) MATCH (new:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $to_key}) WHERE $to_label IN labels(new) AND new <> old MATCH (old)-[r]-(other) WHERE NOT type(r) IN $owned_types WITH DISTINCT old, new, r WITH new, r, type(r) AS rel_type, properties(r) AS props, startNode(r) = old AS outgoing, (startNode(r) = new OR endNode(r) = new) AS between, CASE WHEN startNode(r) = endNode(r) THEN new WHEN startNode(r) = old THEN endNode(r) ELSE startNode(r) END AS other FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (new)-[x]->(other) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (new)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(other) SET moved += props) FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND NOT outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (other)-[x]->(new) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (other)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(new) SET moved += props) DELETE r RETURN count(r) AS moved

shipped:writer.move_foreign_relationship.name: move_foreign_relationships
shipped:writer.move_foreign_relationship.text: MATCH (old:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $from_key}) WHERE $from_label IN labels(old) MATCH (new:SpecNode {group_id: $project_id, uuid: $to_key}) WHERE $to_label IN labels(new) AND new <> old MATCH (old)-[r]-(other) WHERE NOT type(r) IN $owned_types WITH DISTINCT old, new, r WITH new, r, type(r) AS rel_type, properties(r) AS props, startNode(r) = old AS outgoing, (startNode(r) = new OR endNode(r) = new) AS between, CASE WHEN startNode(r) = endNode(r) THEN new WHEN startNode(r) = old THEN endNode(r) ELSE startNode(r) END AS other FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (new)-[x]->(other) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (new)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(other) SET moved += props) FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN NOT between AND NOT outgoing AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (other)-[x]->(new) WHERE type(x) = rel_type AND properties(x) = props } THEN [1] ELSE [] END | CREATE (other)-[moved:$(rel_type)]->(new) SET moved += props) DELETE r RETURN count(r) AS moved
